title: Read-only query interface over the corpus (no PII, no advice)
context: A read-only query interface helps consumers query the corpus by entity/assertion while exposing no PII and no medical advice. Binding cancer guardrails apply: open-access (PMC OA Subset) / aggregate / de-identified data only; no identifiable patient data; no medical advice; provenance on every assertion. Every result returns provenance and only aggregate, grounded, license-permitted content.
objective: Build a read-only query interface over the corpus that exposes no PII and no advice.
acceptanceCriteria: Read-only query interface over the corpus lets consumers query by entity/assertion; returns provenance with every result.
Interface exposes no PII and no medical advice; only aggregate, grounded, license-permitted content is served.
Code MIT-licensed; tests + CI green; DCO signed-off.
